user.title: Connect to YachtSense Link
user.description: Enter the web-interface login for your Raymarine YachtSense Link router.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate YachtSense Link
reauth_confirm.description: The router at {host} rejected the saved login. Re-enter its web-interface credentials.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the router. Check the IP address and that it is on the network.
error.invalid_auth: Login rejected. Check the username and password.
error.rate_limited: Too many failed logins; the router is temporarily locked out. Wait a minute and try again.

abort.already_configured: This YachtSense Link is already configured.
abort.wrong_device: The credentials are for a different YachtSense Link than the one already configured.
